title: How to Make Your Business Message So Clear Customers Instantly Buy
description:
Most businesses struggle to explain what they do, costing them countless customers and sales opportunities. In this inaugural episode of the new StoryBrand Podcast, Donald Miller delivers a masterclass on the framework that's helped thousands of businesses clarify their message and grow their revenue.

You'll discover:
• Why the human brain filters out confusing messages (and how to get past this filter)
• The 7 essential sound bites every business needs to capture customer attention
• How to craft a powerful "one-liner" that makes your value instantly clear
• The exact words that make customers want to buy from you
• Why owning a problem is more important than talking about your product

To get help creating messaging that will grow your business, attend the next StoryBrand Your Business Live workshop where you'll get in-person training from Don Miller and hands-on help from a StoryBrand Certified Guide:  https://storybrand.com/live/?utm_medium=social&utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=sbyourbusiness&utm_term=sb&utm_content=SB_workshop
